title: claim (the company-brain atomic unit)
description: The claim object (amicode #1681, brain flywheel slice 2 — the ONE type namespace): the atomic knowledge unit of the #1679 flywheel. Notes are renderings; machinery operates on claims only. Authoritative shape per the vault spec spec-20261002-090500's data contract (its sketch's 'hypthesis' is a corrected typo). The claim note's frontmatter IS this object — exactly these keys, no render-level extras: provenance rides evidence pointers + the append-only history. Frontmatter-contract pattern (like library-paper/skill): no schema_version.

type.description: the claim's type — the closed vocabulary slice 1's distill pass already types candidates over (jev_curation CLAIM_TYPES). This field dissolves the memory/vault type-namespace collision: in the claims registry `type` speaks ONLY this vocabulary.

statement.description: one addressable sentence — the unit of agreement/disagreement. The projection takes the memory card's description; distill takes the session title.

status.description: the lifecycle. Transitions are stamped by machinery (slice 5); a claim with zero resolvable evidence cannot reach corroborated (the lint enforces it).

confidence.description: the calibrated band. Distill's numeric Jev confidence buckets into this enum via bucketConfidence; the memory-card projection stamps `medium` (a hand-curated card carries no calibration).

evidence.description: pointers into the substrate — MUST resolve (the lint checks). Vocabulary (extends slice 1's): chat-session/<id>, chat-message/<id> (the chat DB), memory-card/<relpath under amicode/memory/> (the vault). May be empty only while unverified.

applied.description: adoption counter — machinery-stamped (recommend-outcome accepted, citation in a solve; slice 4).

last_applied.description: when the adoption counter last moved; null until first applied.

history.description: the append-only trail: entries are never removed or edited, only appended (lifecycle transitions, merges, adoption stamps, projections).

event.description: the closed event vocabulary machinery stamps: created (distill-merge), projected (memory-card projection), merged (dedupe), evidence-added, applied (adoption stamp), corroborated / superseded / refuted (lifecycle).

scope.description: the promotion ladder tier this claim lives at (copy-never-move promotion is slice 6; the projection stamps `personal` — the cards' home).

tags.description: free-form retrieval hooks; the projection preserves the source card's tags verbatim.
